>
[Primal Proportions](/Feats.aspx?ID=5519) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 80

**Archetype** [Wild Mimic](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=226)

**Prerequisites**
[Wild Mimic Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5515)

</column>

---

You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts. You can cast [_enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1514), targeting yourself once per 10 minutes as an innate 2nd-rank primal spell. At 12th level, the spell is heightened to 4th rank.
name: Primal Proportions
